name: Wyoming

examVariants.label: Wyoming knowledge (written) test — Class C, all applicants

retake.waitBetweenAttempts: Retest per local WYDOT office scheduling
retake.retakeFee: Written knowledge test is administered at no separate charge

gdl.passengerLimits: No more than one passenger under 18 who is not immediate family (intermediate permit)

requiredDocuments: Proof of identity/date of birth (e.g. certified birth certificate or U.S. passport)
Two proofs of Wyoming residency showing physical address
Parental/guardian consent and signature if under 18
process.realIdNotes: A REAL ID requires one proof of identity, one proof of SSN, and two proofs of Wyoming residency (originals or certified copies; no photocopies). A standard (non-REAL ID) license is also offered.

facts.pointSuspensionThreshold: No demerit-point system; four moving-violation convictions within 12 months lead to license suspension
facts.moveOverRule: Slow down and, when safe, move over a lane for stopped emergency and service vehicles displaying flashing lights
facts.interstateMaxSpeed: 80 mph on posted Interstate segments (otherwise 75 mph)
facts.schoolZoneSpeed: 20 mph in a posted school zone
